releaseNotes: Android Immersive Sticky Fullscreen: Completely hidden system status bar and bottom gesture bar with seamless shortEdges camera cutout support
Smart Audio Lifecycle: Background music automatically fades out and pauses when switching apps or minimizing, smoothly resuming upon foreground return
Legacy Mode Selection Purged: Direct navigation to the Supercell Hero Lobby with zero vestigial intermediary screens
100% Real Player Matchmaking: Online matchmaking now pairs strictly real human players with zero bot backfilling
4-Digit Numeric Room PINs: Mobile-friendly 4-digit numeric room codes with auto-joining and zero re-generation bugs
Redis Game State Persistence & Reconnect Tokens: Active games and seats survive server restarts with automatic client token reconnection
